# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_027_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 27

**1** "If you do not fast [нностеуе] as regards the world [космос], you will not find [хе] the kingdom [тмнтеро].

**2** If you do not observe the Sabbath [савватон] as a Sabbath [савватон], you will not see the Father."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *нностеуе*: to fast; but here modified by "as regards the world" — fasting FROM the world, not a dietary fast
- *савватон*: Sabbath; Greek loan-word; used twice — "observe the Sabbath as a Sabbath"
- The saying stands in tension with Sayings 6 and 14, which reject fasting and religious observance
- The resolution: Thomas's "fasting" = abstinence from the world (asceticism), not dietary restriction
- The Sabbath: observing the Sabbath AS a Sabbath = finding the true rest, not the day-observance
- cf. P.Oxy 1 lines 4-11 for Greek parallel
